title: Opening and closing a group in the layers list survives a relaunch
goal: Whether a group in the layers list is open or shut is forgotten every time you quit. A picture you are building should look the same when you come back to it.
notes: Open state currently lives in EditorState.expandedGroupIDs, per window, in memory. Persisting it means either a per-document side file keyed by layer UUID, or a field on the document that is deliberately not part of what a document IS. The choice is a UX decision about whether interface state belongs in a shared file: worth a decision card before building.
acceptance: Open a group, quit, reopen the same file: the group is still open
Nothing about opening a group appears in undo, and the file is unchanged by it
A group that no longer exists leaves nothing behind
